text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин does a fantastic job in her
debut
race, but her journey has only just
begun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If she's to be seen as a fully capable
racer, she'll
have to overcome one of the
toughest challenges
out there.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She makes the Classic Triple Crown her
main goal
for next year, and to better
prepare for it, we
decide for her to run
in the Hopeful Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
